boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named PLNU spaces for study, gathering, recreation, reflection, and campus events.

cards.title: Ryan Library
cards.subtitle: Individual study, collaboration, and research
cards.notes: Use the seating and research support for solo work, then reserve or check availability for group work when your project needs a shared table.
cards.short_summary: A library space set up for individual study, collaborative work, and academic research.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says Ryan Library welcomes students for individual study, group collaboration, and academic research, with varied seating.
cards.access_notes: Library services are intended for PLNU students; check current library access guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Nicholson Commons
cards.subtitle: Dining, services, recreation, and student gathering
cards.notes: Meet a classmate here between commitments, using the building’s common services as a practical starting point before heading to your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building combining dining, student services, recreation, and commuter support.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU identifies Nicholson Commons as home to the dining hall, bookstore, coffee shop, Wellness Center, Commuter and Veterans Commons, and Recreation Room.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Locations | Point Loma Nazarene University
cards.access_notes: Some services and rooms have separate operating hours or student-use requirements.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Commons, first floor
cards.notes: If you commute, use the lounge for a quiet study break or a low-key meetup; its tables, computer, printer, and conference room support both.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Nicholson Commons lounge with study and practical amenities for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists the Commuter Lounge’s kitchen, couches, tables, lockers, games, conference room, TV, computer, and printer, and describes it as a quiet study and connection space.
cards.source_title: A Day in the Life of a PLNU Commuter Student | PLNU
cards.access_notes: Designed for commuter students; confirm eligibility and room availability with Commuter Student Services.

cards.title: Activities and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Commons, first floor
cards.notes: Drop in during posted hours to connect with Outdoor Leadership staff, plan an outing, or ask about equipment rentals and student recreation options.
cards.short_summary: The campus base for outdoor recreation information, rentals, and student programming.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU locates its Activities and Recreation Center in Nicholson Commons and says it offers outdoor equipment rentals and student outdoor opportunities.
cards.source_title: Student Leadership and Outdoor Recreation | PLNU
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Monday–Thursday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; Friday 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday noon–5 p.m.; closed Sunday. Rentals may cost extra.

cards.title: Greek Amphitheatre
cards.subtitle: Outdoor gathering, study, and event venue
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet someone on the stepped seating when no scheduled event is using the venue, and leave room for formal campus programs.
cards.short_summary: A historic outdoor amphitheatre used for student milestones, casual study, concerts, and special events.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says students gather at the Greek during Welcome Week and graduation; between events it is a casual meeting and study space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor venue; access may be limited during rehearsals, concerts, commencement, or other scheduled events.

cards.title: McCullough Park
cards.subtitle: Behind the Fermanian School of Business
cards.notes: Settle in for reading or a conversation on the lawn, and look for scheduled Sports and Recreation programming before using the open area.
cards.short_summary: An elevated campus park used for studying, relaxing, yoga, and sunset viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU describes McCullough Park as a place for studying and relaxing and says Sports and Recreation hosts yoga classes there.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Locations | Point Loma Nazarene University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and scheduled classes can affect use; respect any event setup and campus guidance.

cards.title: Prescott Prayer Chapel
cards.subtitle: Prayer and spiritual reflection
cards.notes: Step inside for a quiet period of prayer or reflection, treating the chapel and surrounding memorial features as shared contemplative space.
cards.short_summary: A small campus chapel created from student vision and dedicated to prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says Prescott Prayer Chapel was originally proposed by students as a dedicated prayer space and now provides a peaceful setting for prayer and spiritual reflection.
cards.source_title: Who Are the Buildings on PLNU’s Campus Named After? | PLNU
cards.access_notes: Maintain a quiet, respectful atmosphere; access can change for services or campus needs.

cards.title: Brown Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus worship and community gathering
cards.notes: Check the chapel calendar and attend a gathering that fits your schedule; arrive with your PLNU ID if you need chapel attendance credit.
cards.short_summary: PLNU’s shared worship venue for regular morning and evening chapel gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU schedules morning chapel in Brown Chapel on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, plus Thursday evening Time Out Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Morning chapel is listed at 9:45 a.m. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday; Time Out Chapel is Thursday at 9 p.m. Schedules may change.

cards.title: Crill Performance Hall
cards.subtitle: Cooper Music Center performance venue
cards.notes: Watch the campus event schedule for concerts, lectures, panels, and streamed ceremonies, then confirm whether the particular event needs registration or a ticket.
cards.short_summary: A campus performance hall that hosts presentations and provides additional ceremony viewing space.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s Preview Day schedule uses Crill Performance Hall for welcomes, parent sessions, and academic sessions; PLNU also uses it for commencement broadcasts.
cards.source_title: Preview Schedule | Point Loma Nazarene University
cards.access_notes: Event access varies. PLNU states Crill is adjacent to the Greek Amphitheatre and provides additional seating for commencement broadcasts.

cards.title: Alumni Lawn
cards.subtitle: Outdoor lawn for PLNU community events
cards.notes: Check the event calendar before heading over; the lawn is used as a meeting point and activity site during organized university and community programs.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lawn used for PLNU runs, volunteer events, and community-oriented gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s Homecoming schedule places the We Are Loma 5K on Alumni Lawn, and PLNU’s DS Action event uses the Alumni House Lawn for its student-volunteer egg hunt.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event space; use is subject to university scheduling and event-specific registration rules.
